Leading Brands and Producers
Olivado:
Famous globally for inventing and standardizing the cold-pressed avocado oil extraction method keeping temperatures low to preserve nutrients.
olivado.com
Grove / Avocado Oil New Zealand:
Based in Tauranga, producing extra virgin cold-pressed oils winning international taste awards.
Midlands Nutrition (Midlands NZ):
A large vertically integrated processor offering bulk oils, retail bottles, and custom wellness products.
LUVO (Seeka Ltd):
Crafts premium oils from locally grown fruit that is not destined for traditional export markets.
www.luvoil.co.nz
Annavocado:
Focuses on traceable, farm-to-capsule nutritional products using New Zealand Hass avocados.
